attributes.value: The Abstract prints ESMFold monomer accuracy as 76%: 'On the other hand, ESMFold accurately predicted 76% of the monomeric proteins and 41% of the dimeric proteins.' The Discussion prints 77%: 'For monomeric proteins, AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 exhibited comparable performance, each accurately predicting 87%–88% of the structures, while ESMFold achieved 77% accuracy.' Table 1 and the Results give ESMFold 832 accurate predictions (50%) and 430 with domain movement (26%) out of 1,666 monomers. The paper does not print the sum; 832 + 430 = 1,262 of 1,666 is 75.75% (computed here, not printed), which rounds to the Abstract's 76%, not to the Discussion's 77%.
